guards: skill markdown over 12,000 chars may not grow, one under it may not cross, and an improvement must be locked in rather than left at the old high-water mark

poisonPill.why: An under-limit skill reference (telemetry.md, about 3.4K chars) replaced by a 13.5K one: the tree as it would look if skill markdown crept past the limit unchallenged. Measured 2026-10-14: 13 of 17 SKILL.md files already exceed the 12,000-char target and coordination.md grew twice in one day. The pill needs no file to stay in the debt ledger, which an understated-baseline fixture would (trimming ship below the limit turns its GREW into DROPPED).
